turns.customer: My order #1054 never arrived and the tracking hasn't moved in weeks. What's going on?
turns.reply:
I'm sorry this happened — that's frustrating, and I want to make it right.

Here's what's going on: your order (#1054, one Loft Down Jacket, $199.00) was lost in transit by the carrier, Parcelway. The last tracking update was an exception on 2026-08-28 in Portland, OR, when the carrier couldn't locate the package, and they declared it lost on 2026-09-03. It won't be arriving.

I've submitted a refund request for the full $199.00. No refund has gone out yet — a team member needs to approve it first, which usually happens within one business day. You don't need to do anything; once approved, the refund is issued to your original payment method.

Thanks for your patience while the carrier lost your package.
